message.content: In the month of May, Hailey Johnson offered several special offerings at her bakery. A notable event was a free baking class hosted on a specific weekend, which attracted LiHua to attend. Additionally, in the middle of May, Hailey Johnson introduced a 20% off bread promotion, encouraging customers to visit on the 30th of the month to take advantage of the discounted prices. Furthermore, in early May, a special event was held where a new line of healthy bread options was launched, and LiHua was invited to participate in a tasting session. These special events and promotions demonstrate Hailey's efforts to engage customers and introduce new products to maintain customer interest and satisfaction throughout the month of May.
